title: This is an excellent tour
text: We had an excellent time and Isabel was very knowledgeable about the Sagrada Família, making the tour an engaging and fun experience. She was also extremely accommodating to my mom that is now 85 years old, so for those who are travelling with your parents I highly recommend it.
author: A5780RMcarolinap

title: We enjoyed our tour, we...
text: We enjoyed our tour, we went in the afternoon for the afternoon sun and it was beautiful. Nester was very knowledgeable!
author: Samantha_M

title: Engaging tour of the Sagrada Família - perfect for families with children
text: Jaume was a very engaging and enthusiastic guide, who managed to make all the historical and architectural information related to the Sagrada Familia both interesting and informative to both parents and children alike.  Highly recommend.
author: Amanda_C

title: Great for Families
text: Fantastic tour with Roberto, so informative and we learned so much about the design and mythology behind it. HIGHLY recommend this organised visit, we travelled with 3 pre teen children and this helped to keep their attention and interest. We all learned something too!
author: Welshgirl78

title: Very family friendly,...
text: Very family friendly, recommend week day as it was not as crowded. Also did an early evening and was not as busy. Gloria was our guide and she was fabulous! She was great with our daughter in explaining things. She was so energetic and really personalized the tour for us. I would highly recommend her!
author: Danielle_M
